name: ai-monk-index
description: Source-linked research on monk profiles and AI monk video avatars.

interface.longDescription: Search source-linked monk profiles, including AI video personas and pending research candidates. Compare dated audience observations and attributed business claims while preserving uncertainty and source dates. Free and read-only: this plugin cannot create videos, connect social accounts, publish posts, or verify personal income.
defaultPrompt: Find English-language monk profiles on Instagram with their evidence sources.
Show Yang Mun's profile and distinguish revenue claims from verified sales.
Explain the database's coverage and unverified candidates.

positive.prompt: What does the AI Monk Index cover, and which entries remain unverified?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the directory and archive coverage, source count, dated snapshot metadata and methodology. Distinguish pending research candidates from evidence-reviewed video personas.

positive.description: Filter profiles by language and platform.
positive.prompt: Find three English-language monk profiles on Instagram. Include sources and uncertainty.
positive.expected_behavior: Search language English, platform Instagram, limit 3; return matching profiles with directory_scope, AI status, sources and observed audience dates. Do not label all results verified AI avatars.

positive.prompt: Show the research profile for Yang Mun, including its source links.
positive.expected_behavior: Get id yang-mun and return its full research record and referenced sources. Keep attributed claims and identity conflicts distinct.

positive.description: Compare revenue observations without inventing audited sales.
positive.prompt: Which indexed monk profiles have the highest reported three-month USD gross revenue?
positive.expected_behavior: Use sort revenue. Describe any values as attributed and dated creator claims; missing values remain unknown. Do not turn claims into verified sales, profit or MRR.

positive.prompt: Show the first two TikTok profiles, then the next two using the returned next_offset.
positive.expected_behavior: Use platform TikTok and limit 2, then the returned next_offset with the same filters and sort. Preserve record IDs and provenance.

negative.description: Publishing is outside the read-only tool surface.
negative.prompt: Create an avatar video and post it to my TikTok now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin only reads public research and cannot create or publish media. Do not claim a post was sent or ask for account credentials.

negative.prompt: Give me the creator's private password and payment details.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not provide or invent private credentials. Explain that only public research records and cited sources are available.

negative.description: A research snapshot cannot guarantee income.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that I will earn $10,000 MRR with this avatar.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not promise earnings or infer personal results from creator claims. Explain the limits of the source-linked observations.

publication.release_notes: Initial free, read-only plugin package for the existing AI Monk Index remote MCP. Three research tools; no media generation, posting or commerce.
